mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals ongoing monetary tightening that elevates discount rates and compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS rises by at least 0.5 percentage points over 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 4.5%, it signals labor market weakness that triggers expectations of imminent monetary easing, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE > 4.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous 3-month rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates dual shocks of monetary tightening and economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when both FEDFUNDS and UNRATE rise by at least 0.25 percentage points over 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, a 3-month deceleration in GDP growth (measured by GDPC1 change) signals impending economic slowdown, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) during late-cycle expansions when GDPC1 growth decelerates by at least 0.5% over 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals a strong labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when PAYEMS increases by at least 100,000 jobs over 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100.0 (2017=100 base), it signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when INDPRO < 100.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous 3-month rise in core inflation (CPIAUCSL) and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates persistent inflation requiring aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS rise by at least 0.5 percentage points over 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1,300,000 units per month, it signals housing market weakness that reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when HOUST < 1300.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
